name: M's If it is true...
source:
Two persons are attacked at a southern island - one is found hit with a blunt object and another one kidnapped. The investigators got a clue to the incident, and winning in mahjong is needed to unwind the case further.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
南部岛屿上有两人遭到袭击，其中一人被钝器击中，另一人被绑架。调查人员得到了事件的线索，需要在麻将中获胜才能进一步侦破案件。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
